intro: Part 2: an indirect question. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: In reported speech, «at» introduces a statement and «om» can introduce a yes/no question. The tenses do not change mechanically: keep the meaning and the time reference of the text.
